newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD base price $7.7-11 bln-report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD base price $7.7-11 bln-report.

text.p: Independent consultants have recommended a base price between $7.7-11.0 billion for Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), national CBN radio reported Wednesday.
A spokeswoman for Planning Minister Antonio Kandir declined to confirm the report.

"You will have to wait for the minister to announce the price," she said, pointing out that the minimum price for an initial block sale of 40-45 percent of voting shares had still to be agreed by the National Privatization Council (CND).
The CND was due to meet at 1000 local/1300 GMT and Kandir was expected to give a news conference immediately afterwards.
In addition to setting the mining group's minimum price, the CND was also expected to agree on a firm date for the initial block sale, slated for April.
The CVRD privatization will be Latin America's biggest privatization to date.
The government is selling off its 51 percent stake in the firm, which is the world's largest iron ore exporter and a major producer of gold, copper and other metals.
